findings.evidence: `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Artanh.lean:81`: `theorem artanh_tanh (x : ℝ) : artanh (tanh x) = x` — unconditional. Also `h` is already implied by `hy`, since `tanh y ∈ Ioo (-1) 1` forces the quotient into `(-1,1)`.
findings.fix: Drop `h`: `theorem rapidity_eq_of_tanh_eq {v n} {y : ℝ} (hy : tanh y = ⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ / (‖n‖ * v.timeComponent)) : v.rapidity n = y := by rw [rapidity_def, ← hy, artanh_tanh]`.
findings.issue: `rapidity_eq_of_tanh_eq` carries `h : |⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ| < ‖n‖ * v.timeComponent`, which the statement does not need; the characterisation holds for every real `y`.

findings.evidence: Line 137 proof body: `tanh_artanh (div_mem_Ioo_neg_one_one_of_abs_lt_abs (h.trans_le (le_abs_self _)))` — the hypothesis is weakened to the abs form before use; the PR's own helper `div_mem_Ioo_neg_one_one_of_abs_lt_abs` (Mathematics/Algebra/Order/Field/Basic.lean:22) and `rapidity_eq_zero_of_abs_timeComponent_le` (line 121) are both stated in that abs form.
findings.fix: State it with `h : |⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ| < |‖n‖ * v.timeComponent|`; the proof becomes `tanh_artanh (div_mem_Ioo_neg_one_one_of_abs_lt_abs h)`. Callers holding the one-sided bound add `h.trans_le (le_abs_self _)`. Leave `exp_rapidity`/`exp_two_mul_rapidity`/`rapidity_eq_half_log` as they are — the square roots there need the sign.
findings.issue: `tanh_rapidity` assumes the one-sided `|⟪v.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ| < ‖n‖ * v.timeComponent`, stronger than the `|x| < |y|` bound the proof actually uses, so the past-directed case the module docstring advertises (line 27, `|v_∥| < -v⁰`) is unreachable from the API.

summary: Prior generality findings are fixed (unrestricted sqrt_minkowskiProduct_self_pos; real-photon family now on the light-cone hypothesis). Two remaining over-strong hypotheses in Rapidity.lean: rapidity_eq_of_tanh_eq needs no hypothesis at all, and tanh_rapidity needs only the absolute-value bound its own proof weakens to.
